effect.statement: High defect rate in solder joint quality: 3.2% of boards show cold solder joints on BGAs and fine-pitch connectors after reflow.

causes.cause: Reflow oven operator not following temperature ramp procedure; skipping pre-heat dwell time.
causes.evidence: Observed operator advancing ramp screen without waiting 30s pre-heat hold. Time study showed average dwell 8s vs. spec 30s.

causes.cause: Training on new solder paste specification not conducted after supplier change.
causes.evidence: Paste lot change from supplier A to B (different flux chemistry); no training provided to assembly team.

causes.cause: Operator fatigue during 10+ hour shifts; visual inspection (AOI) operator misses some defects.
causes.evidence: Peak defects observed in third shift (10pm-6am); AOI reject rate 1.2% vs. final inspection 3.2%.

causes.cause: Reflow profile temperature ramp rates not validated for new solder paste flux chemistry.
causes.evidence: Old profile used 2C/s ramp; new flux (lower Tg) requires 3C/s per datasheet; boards exhibit slower wetting.

causes.cause: No wet-to-liquid bridge test (WLBT) or flux activity monitoring during process qualification.
causes.evidence: Process window study incomplete; no measurement of flux activity or oxide reduction.

causes.cause: Solder paste inspection interval too long (8 hours); paste rheology degradation not detected.
causes.evidence: Paste bottles opened >6 hours before reflow; viscosity increases, reducing solder flow.

causes.cause: Reflow oven thermocouple calibration overdue; temperature reading drift of +8C undetected.
causes.evidence: Oven calibration cert shows last check 18 months ago (due every 12 months); recent cal check found +8C error.

causes.cause: Nitrogen atmosphere purity drifting below 95%; oven N2 generator filter not changed regularly.
causes.evidence: Oxygen analyzer showed 6.2% O2 (spec <2%); N2 generator air filter change history shows >500 hours since last service.

causes.cause: Solder paste supplier changed mid-production; lot-to-lot variation in flux activity and particle size.
causes.evidence: Paste lots from supplier B show 8-12% wider particle size distribution vs. supplier A (statistical analysis).

causes.cause: PCB copper pad surface roughness increased due to new laminate supplier; reduced wetting angle.
causes.evidence: New FR-4 laminate batch shows Cu Ra = 1.8 um vs. spec 0.8-1.2 um; contact angle +15 degrees.

causes.cause: Lead-free solder alloy (SAC305) sensitivity to moisture in paste; moisture content >0.5%.
causes.evidence: Paste moisture meter (Karl Fischer) reads 0.58% vs. spec <0.4%; paste stored in humid area before use.

causes.cause: AOI (automated optical inspection) camera focus drifting; soft-focus images miss fine-pitch solder bridges.
causes.evidence: High-magnification verification images show AOI misses ~40% of cold joints; camera lens focus manual and unstable.

causes.cause: No X-ray inspection for BGA defects; AOI cannot see under BGA ball array.
causes.evidence: Final assembly X-ray reveals voids and cold joints in BGA corner positions undetected by AOI.

causes.cause: Seasonal humidity spike (April-May) increases moisture absorption in solder paste during open-air storage.
causes.evidence: Humidity in production area 65-75% RH during spring; paste storage cabinet humidity meter not functioning.

causes.cause: Ambient temperature swings (18-28C) affect reflow oven heat-up time and process window stability.
causes.evidence: Morning ramp times longer; afternoon shorter; process window shifts by ~10 seconds peak time.
